content:
[Verse 1]
[E]We shed tears
for movie scenes
No real fears,
fake feelings
[C#m]It's a
sentimental wasteland
[E]

[Verse 2]
[E]We're young enough
to lose teeth
But not old
enough for enemies
[C#m]Still
steering with both hands
[E]

[Chorus]
[A]We were just
kids living young and naïve
[E]Running round
streets like the King and the Queen
[A]Gas light
flicker in your eye, what are hope-
[E]less dreams?
[A]Staying out
waiting 'til they call off the search
[E]Chewing gum,
cherry coke until our brains burned
[A]A sugar drunk
high, we were the on-
[E]ly ones

[Verse 3]
[E]The bitter taste
of nicotine
Still alive
on my coat and jeans
[C#m]But you were the light that I saw
standing in front of the sun
[E]You were the girl on the hill singing
all night, all night

[Chorus]
[A]We were just
kids living young and naïve
[E]Running round
streets like the King and the Queen
[A]Gas light
flicker in your eye, what are hope-
[E]less dreams?
[A]Staying out
waiting 'til they call off the search
[E]Chewing gum,
cherry coke until our brains burned
[A]A sugar drunk
high, we were the on-
[E]ly ones
Maybe never be

[Interlude]
[A]found
Like a drop in the
[C#m]ocean
If we ever grow
[A]up
We'll be gone in the
moment
